Kaur, who is reportedly Aggarwal’s personal assistant, has been charged with two counts of intentionally encouraging or assisting the commission of sexual assault offences by him. The arrests followed complaints of sexual assault at the property. Three of the charges against Aggarwal concern alleged incidents involving a woman on August 9.
